convert_t2i_adapter_checkpoint: convert a T2I-Adapter checkpoint from original format to diffusers format using the full adapter architecture
convert_light_adapter_checkpoint: convert a T2I-Adapter-Light checkpoint from original format to diffusers format using the light adapter architecture
run_adapter_conversion_cli: run the conversion script with --checkpoint_path, --output_path, and optional --is_adapter_light flags
review_convert_adapter_function: review the convert_adapter function that maps original body layer weights to diffusers T2IAdapter state dict format
review_convert_light_adapter_function: review the convert_light_adapter function that maps original body layer weights to diffusers light adapter state dict format
